My dad was part of the team that developed some of the first mobile networks in the 90s. He's one of the inspirations that brought me to become an engineer. He is also one of the most generous people I know. He's the kind of person that takes time off from work to visit five pharmacies and find you medication, just so you won't have to. I wish I was as selfless and humble as him!  Thank you 🤗
